progress_events.note: V063A native list and stable addresses done; V063B adds latest user/assistant projection with explicit IDs and partial semantics.

Implemented owned OpenCode recent-message projection in crates/herder/src/adapters/opencode/read.rs: GET history independently filtered newest-first user and assistant slots; preserves native message IDs/time/text, extracts assistant text parts, leaves turn/reply refs and truncation unknown, and derives partial=false only when native completion timestamp exists. Auth/address validation and request IDs retained. Verified diff --check and rustfmt +stable. `cargo check --manifest-path crates/herder/Cargo.toml` succeeds for origin/main’s crate, but does not compile this reader because central lib.rs currently exposes only opencode::connection. Fresh origin/main advanced to 67aebe8b and removes read.rs while changing connection and main integrates; main-thread module wiring remains central ownership (lib.rs/Cargo.toml excluded). Need Terra’s integration decision/current source boundary before an honest compile + commit/rebase; no tests run per instruction.
